objective_for_doctor: Evaluate and manage a patient presenting with epigastric discomfort and cramping pain.

turns.doctor_opening: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on?
turns.patient_opening: Doctor: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on? Patient: For the past two hours I’ve had epigastric discomfort with cramping pain, and it feels similar to episodes I’ve had before, mostly after eating. I’ve also lost some weight recently because I’ve been avoiding meals to prevent the pain.

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any yellowing of your skin or the whites of your eyes?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any yellowing of my skin or the whites of my eyes. My main issue has been the epigastric discomfort and cramping pain that tends to happen after I eat.”

turns.doctor_question: Do you feel stiffness in your joints or muscles when you wake up in the morning? If yes, does it usually improve as you move around?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I don’t really notice stiffness in my joints or muscles when I wake up in the morning. If anything, my knee pain is more persistent rather than stiffness that improves after moving.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been feeling confused lately—like you’re having trouble thinking clearly, staying oriented, or understanding what’s going on?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t been confused or had any trouble thinking clearly, staying oriented, or understanding what’s going on. It’s mainly the epigastric discomfort and cramping pain after I eat that’s been bothering me.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been having night sweats—waking up with your clothes or bedding damp—recently? (Yes or no)
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any night sweats or waking up with my clothes or bedding damp.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed a lump or swelling in your thigh that feels like it’s within the muscle (not just on the skin)?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any lump or swelling in my thigh, and I haven’t felt anything that seems like it’s within the muscle. My symptoms have been focused on the epigastric discomfort and cramping pain, especially after eating.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any skin lesions, sores, or unusual bumps along the veins on your arms (for example, in a line where a vein runs)?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any skin lesions, sores, or unusual bumps along the veins on my arms. I’m really just dealing with the epigastric discomfort and cramping pain, mostly after I eat.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you ever worked in a job where you might breathe in metal dust or metal fumes—for example welding, grinding, cutting, machining, construction/renovation with metal, or working in a foundry or metal workshop? (Yes or no)
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t worked in welding, grinding, or any metal-related jobs where I might breathe in metal dust or fumes. My work doesn’t involve metal workshops or construction/renovation with metal.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any bony enlargement or swelling around your joints (for example, fingers, knuckles, knees, or hips), such as bumps that seem to be part of the bone rather than just soft swelling?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any bony enlargement or swelling around my joints like bumps on my fingers, knuckles, or hips—just the knee pain I already have, which feels persistent rather than swollen or stiff.”
